finalText:
Written to `HANDOFF-2026-07-04.md` — root cause, minute-by-minute timeline, and the two things that turned a Redis outage into a dead service.

Impact window is `02:14:07Z` to `02:31:52Z`, 17 minutes 45 seconds. The log stops at the kill, so recovery time isn't in there.

I could not give you the ioredis version. This repo has no lockfile and no `node_modules`, so all that exists is the range `^5.4.1`. That could be several releases off what ran in prod, so the doc says not to read the changelog against 5.4.1. Run `npm ls ioredis` on the prod host and I'll fill it in.
